sections.description: Pet Food Store WordPress Theme is low cost template for people selling pet food of different brands in their shop or developing pet food products. Your entire ecosystem can be effectively displayed from products you deal in, to how to buy from your online store. It is a pre-designed template but it can be customized to suit your requirements like brand color, uploading of your company logo etc. When you download and install Pet Food Store WordPress Theme you can get access to the Dashboard from where you can make changes and customize background colors etc. as per your need. From digital menu, product catalogue, you can display everything. We provide sticky header neatly divided sections to display your products and information. You can display address, logo, link your social media pages on icons provided. You can add list of new products, change prices of products, and make discount or new product launch announcements easily without coding or programing knowledge.  Compared to custom built website it is faster to make your online store live using Pet Food Store WordPress Theme saves you time and money as it is a pre-designed page. You can add product pages, and other pages like blog sections, testimonial page etc. yourself.  Pet Food Store WordPress Theme is compatible with plugins like woo-commerce which adds safe online payment feature to your store. This enables people to make online purchases. It is a mobile friendly design that will adjust itself without any distortion on any screen your customer may be visiting your store on.  This template simplifies pet food store management as you can add products, change prices, announce discount or launch of new pet food product easily. If you offer pet diet consultation you can display the service in the sections provided. Pet Food Store WordPress Theme is responsive, mobile and browser friendly theme.
